name: Song facts
author: Voltage
description: Everything about a song: when it came out, who wrote and produced it, what it samples, the artist's story, and with a free Genius token what it means, line-by-line explanations (double meanings and references) and the album's story. In its own window (right-click a song > Song facts, or Ctrl+K), in the full player's Details tab and under the song in Discovery.

settings.label: Genius access token (free: genius.com/api-clients > New API Client > Generate Access Token)
